headline: Are you looking for:
description:
THC: is the primary psychoactive compound in cannabis, responsible for the high by acting on the brain's cannabinoid receptors.
CBD: is widely considered a non-intoxicating, therapeutic compound derived from hemp that does not produce the high associated with THC.

children.label: Eat
children.headline: Edible Products:
children.description:
Gummy: Cannabis gummy products are defined as edible, chewable confections infused with cannabis.
Baked Goods: Cannabis baked goods are defined as edible products such as Chocolate Bars, Chocolate Covered Oreos, Cookies, Popcorn, Pretzels, Puppy Chow and Toffee infused with cannabis.

Flower: Cannabis flower, often called bud, refers to the smokable, harvested, and dried female reproductive part of the cannabis plant.
